questions: Your Methods and Note 1 report three devices and four datasets, all shown. Were other devices fabricated or cooled down, for example ones with unstable QPCs, and how many showed the excess noise?
If any devices, cooldowns or QPC tunings were set aside, why?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: field across the 5/2 plateau, QPC transmissions outside about 0.75 to 0.95, bias beyond |e*V_S/2k_BT| of about 6, temperatures above 10 mK?
What does the tuning that agrees least with the PH-Pf curves look like, and did any tuning give Fano factors outside both predictions?

Were the QPC gate voltages the same in both configurations? In Fig. S1, R_QPC1 is about 0.2 in panel (a) and about 0.1 in panel (e), so QPC1's e/4 charge in panel (f) comes from a different transmission than its detection role in panel (c).

Could you run the Note 3 heating model on data sets 1 to 3 (Fig. S9 uses set 4; Fig. 3b uses set 3), and say how it changes if more of the dissipated power enters the neutral sector than the central-charge split assumes?

How did you determine the 10 mK electron temperature, and how far do the curves in Figs. 2b and 3b move for a few mK of error? Did you vary the dilution at the injection QPC, whose effect your theory predicts?
What would an Abelian 5/2 order with an upstream neutral mode, or no braiding, predict for F_neutral in Fig. 3b? Both curves shown carry M_n = 0.
